searchText: Is Matic (PoS) even a layer 2? Was that terminology not reserved for plasma/rollups? From what I can see it's a sidechain with ~100 validators that checkpoints to mainnet every 3 hours. I don't get the hype. hi where can i ask about web3 <:PepoG:711180078423212072> > I'm asking them to pay when I reach 1 eth but they keep paying me weekly anyway Can't accumulate your coins for ages, it's not a bank. There are 300k miners on ethermine, imagine everyone would accumulate until they reach 1 ETH. Low amounts will be sent out once a month and more features coming soon to reduce "spam" :).
